steps.title: Base: plate + tower, turntable servo inside
steps.how: A 3 mm plate with a hollow tower: the small MG90S stands inside, spline up at the centre, 2 tab screws from above; the 6807 presses into the tower top. Two cups take sand or washers as ballast. Prints in a fraction of the old 52 mm box.

steps.title: Turret: hub, plate and the shoulder-servo cradle in one
steps.how: The hub goes into the bearing; the MG90S's horn screws under it. A frame on the plate holds the MG996R on its side, spline pointing sideways: it is the shoulder.

steps.title: Arm + wrist servo
steps.how: One printed arm: hub on the MG996R's round horn, a beam out to the same wrist bracket as Concept A. It replaces the 2 rods, 4 LM6UU, carriage, spine, top cap, crank and link.

steps.title: Claw (unchanged)
steps.how: The existing gripper frame, gears, fingers and SG90, on the wrist horn exactly as now.

steps.title: Lift = tilt the arm
steps.how: The MG996R tilts the arm up 7.1°: the can, 127 mm out, rises 15.7 mm (≥ 15.2). It comes back to the same angle to put the can down, so it lands level. Watch it in ▶.
